title: Auto-Sorter Inventory
description: Adds a button to sort your inventory with a single click!
body:
# Auto-Sorter Inventory

Adds a button to your inventory that sorts all items with a single click!

## Features
- **One-Click Sorting**: No more messy inventories.
- **Smart Merging**: Automatically merges incomplete stacks.
- **Minecraft Style**: The "Sort" button fits perfectly into the default UI.
- **Fast and Efficient**: Sorting logic is handled on the server for maximum reliability.

## Installation
1. Install [Minecraft Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/) for version 1.16.5.
2. Download the mod `.jar` file.
3. Place the file in your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
4. Launch the game and enjoy!
